description: On Oct. 1, Kristin Kassner was given the Massachusetts Legislator of the Year Award by the Massachusetts Municipal Lawyers’ Association. Kristin is one of 200 Massachusetts legislators, a junior one, and from a small town. The MMLA hadn’t felt compelled to select anyone to honor for seven years. Ho
paid_for_by: Paid for by The Committee to Elect Kristin Kassner
title: Letter: Kassner Named Massachusetts Legislator of the Year by Municipal Lawyers — Kristin Kassner for State Representative
